GTABase - GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5, Xbox Series)

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableNote: Safe: pops when the other 54 trophies are earned; no multiplayer or DLC is needed.
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Single-player only, no DLC, no difficulty setting.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies in single-player; there is no online trophy and no DLC trophy.
The platinum pops automatically once the last of the 54 is earned.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableNote: Safe: an unmissable story trophy from the opening mission.
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

steps.text: Start Chapter 1 and play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops automatically and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableNote: Safe: an unmissable story trophy; it pops as Chapter 2 begins.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1; the trophy pops when Chapter 2 opens with its first mission.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 1 to its end.
Start the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag?, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableNote: Safe: an unmissable story trophy; it pops as Chapter 3 begins.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2; the trophy pops when Chapter 3 opens with its first mission.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 2 to its end.
Start the first Chapter 3 mission, Welcome to Vice City, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableNote: Safe: an unmissable story trophy; it pops early in Chapter 4.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3; the trophy pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 3 to its end.
Complete the first two Chapter 4 missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableNote: Safe: an unmissable story trophy from the last Chapter 4 mission.
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4; the trophy pops after its final mission, Starting From Zero.

steps.text: Play through Chapter 4 to its end.
Complete the final Chapter 4 mission, Starting From Zero, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableNote: Safe: an unmissable story trophy. Keep a manual save from just before the final mission, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. The sources disagree on which chapter it sits in, so keep a manual save from just before it.

steps.text: Play through the story to the final mission, keeping a manual save from just before it.
Complete the final mission; the trophy pops and free roam continues after the credits.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx repeats the Chapter 4 mission name Starting From Zero for the final mission, the same text it gives for Top Of The World, Ma, which looks like a copy error; eGamers notes Beebom and CULTR word the final mission as Chapter 5; GTABase names no chapter, only the last mission of the story.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableNote: Watch: a top-3 entry claims a one-time scene window inside Breakfast Run, but that claim was not found in the guide sources read here, so it is not raised to possibly missable.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 2 and play the mission Breakfast Run.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops automatically and cannot be missed.

trophies.missableNote: Watch: a top-3 entry claims a one-time heist set-piece window, but that claim was not found in the guide sources read here, so it is not raised to possibly missable.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 3 and play the mission The Cartel Heist.
Finish the heist mission; the trophy pops automatically and cannot be missed.

trophies.missableNote: Watch: a top-3 entry claims a one-time errand window mid-mission, attributed to OutputLag, but that claim was not found in the OutputLag text read here, so it is not raised to possibly missable.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 4 and play the mission Child's Play.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops automatically and cannot be missed.

trophies.missableNote: Watch: a top-3 entry claims a one-time venue set-piece window, but that claim was not found in the guide sources read here, so it is not raised to possibly missable.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission Headliners; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

Finish the mission; the trophy pops automatically and cannot be missed.

trophies.missableNote: Watch: a top-3 entry claims KeenGamer names a one-time window in the takedown, but that claim was not verified in the KeenGamer text read here, so it is not raised to possibly missable.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 4 and play the mission VCIA Takedown.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops automatically and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableNote: Watch: a top-3 entry claims a one-time approach window before the alarm changes, but that claim was not found in the guide sources read here, so it is not raised to possibly missable.
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory; the trophy pops when the mission ends.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 5 and play the mission Operation Savage Glory.
Finish the mission; the trophy pops automatically and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableNote: Safe: the checklist opens after the story, earlier progress already counts, and nothing on it is missable.
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist only appears after the story, but everything you do before then already counts, and nothing on it is missable. It asks for roughly 60% of true completion, not everything.

steps.text: After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see the checklist; progress made during the story already counts.
Complete any 100 optional missions; there are 200-300 in total, so missed ones do not matter.
Scan any 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles with the WAiNK app and study any 100 of the 255 animals with binoculars.
Complete 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, and 15 of the 18 meditations.
Finish every robbery the checklist demands: all 39 gang operations, all 8 bank vaults, 22 bank jobs and 7 Payday Loan jobs.
Finish the collectible side: 15 of the 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks.
Win 30 of the 40 unique races, earn all 42 Shooting Range gold medals and win all 42 drone races at the 14 Top Fun locations.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableNote: Safe: stunts stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts; the checklist wants 300, so keep going past the trophy.

steps.text: Complete any 250 stunts in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps.
Flying under bridges is the quickest kind; the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed, just performing it counts.
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts and on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots; every stunt has a unique name and stays marked once done.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: every activity type stays available in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once; most come naturally while working on other trophies.

steps.text: Do each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (score a hoop), playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt.
Check what is left under Touchpad > Progress > Activities; the menu shows how many of each type you have done.
Filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon); most types are marked there and the story introduces most of them on its own.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: shooting ranges stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. The sources disagree on how many ranges hold them: 12 or 2.

steps.text: Visit the shooting ranges and earn a gold medal in all 42 challenges; the total of 42 is agreed by both guides.
PowerPyx and GTABase count 12 range locations, while OutputLag counts 2 ranges holding 42 medals between them; follow the in-game list either way.
Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx lists 12 Shooting Range locations holding 42 gold medals and GTABase agrees with 12 ranges; OutputLag says there are two shooting ranges with 42 gold medals between them. The 42 total is agreed.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: drone races stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations; the checklist wants all 42 races.

steps.text: Win at least one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
For 100% completion, win all 42 drone races across those locations, so finish each location while you are there.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableNote: Safe: races stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeats do not count, and there are 40 unique race locations.

steps.text: Win 20 different races; winning the same race again does not count.
There are 40 unique race locations to choose from; the 100% checklist wants 30 of them won.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: Cal's fishing questline stays available after the story.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge after meeting him in Chapter 1.

steps.text: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), wait for Cal's text message, which marks a fishing spot with a purple icon west of Key Lento.
Follow Cal's fishing questline at the marked spot.
Beat Cal in his fishing challenge to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableNote: Safe: arcade games stay playable after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete any one of the 4 arcade games; finishing all of its levels once is enough.

steps.text: There are 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck.
Play the first three on the TV at home using the controllers, available from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines out in the world.
Finish all levels of any one game at least once; you do not need to beat all of its challenges.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: Andy's quests stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest line; it is Lucia-only and starts in Chapter 3.

steps.text: In Chapter 3, while playing as Lucia, wait for Andy's call, then her text with her home address in Belville; the questline is marked automatically.

Complete the 5 Andy quests in order: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation), Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van), Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse).
All quests stay available after the story; the trophy pops after the final one.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: Kenton returns in Chapters 2-3 and his quests stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's treasure-diving line: 7 shipwrecks in total.

steps.text: The questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1; after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), he calls and is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive at the purple treasure chest markers he marks on the map; use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor and bring it back to Kenton.
After the first set, he calls you back to his shop and marks more locations; in total he wants 7 shipwrecks cleared.
Track progress under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.
Kenton goes away after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3 while playing as Jason; calling Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 speeds his return, so he is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: Billy's quests stay available after the story.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5-quest line at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, the questline is marked automatically at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Complete the 5 Billy quests in order: Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club), Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (Steal the Impaler), Hometown Heroes.
All quests stay available after the story; the trophy pops after Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Disputed: OutputLag calls Race Against Yago time-sensitive; PowerPyx says all strangers stay available after the story. Safe play: do the race as soon as it appears and save first.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying stranger mission strands. Only certain strands count, and the sources disagree on whether one of them can be missed.

steps.text: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands; the game tracks the count in the trophy list.
Confirmed to count: Kirk (Skunk Ape quests), Kyle (McKittrick Farm quests), Yago (street racing quests) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile and deliveries).
Do not count: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie; they have their own trophies or are not strangers to the game.
Do Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 the moment it appears: OutputLag flags it time-sensitive with an hourglass icon, so save first, then race.
PowerPyx says all strangers are still there after the story in free roam; more qualifying strands are still being discovered, so check the counter after each strand.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx says all Strangers & Freaks are still there after the story, while OutputLag flags the Chapter 3 race Race Against Yago as time-sensitive (hourglass icon) and says to do it the moment it appears. A single-source note also warns that stranger chains have windows tied to story progress.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: Randy's Wish List can be finished after the story.
trophies.guide: Deliver the 16 sports cars on Randy's Wish List.

steps.text: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy), the questline Randy's Wish List is marked automatically, and the mission unlocks the Key Cloner.

The Zorrusso is delivered automatically during that mission; 15 more cars remain on the list, including the Pegassi Vitello, Pegassi Infernus, Buckingham Windsor Drop, Pegassi Toros and Pegassi Tempesta.
Track the list under Map > Robberies (money bag icon) > Randy's Wish List; scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to check whether one is wanted.
Drive each wanted car back to Randy's garage, marked by the green RK icon in the west of Vice City; a car delivered in good condition pays more.
Cars show up often in the east of Vice City at Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels or in traffic; the whole list can be finished after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: the questline stays available after the story. Unconfirmed: the guides do not give the exact number of labs to destroy.
trophies.guide: Destroy Tyrone's Synthetic Labs as Jason, then finish his second quest. The exact number of labs is not given by the guides.

steps.text: After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, the questline is marked automatically; it is Jason-only, not Lucia.
Go to the purple Synthetic Labs markers in Vice City and destroy the labs in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter.
After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs); finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.targetLabel: labs destroyed (count not given by the guides)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Possibly missable: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1. Safe play: do it in Chapter 1 and keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 1 until the trophy pops.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. The Chapter 1 balcony meditation is the one possibly missable moment in the whole list.

steps.text: There are 18 meditation spots across 10 locations; meditating with Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts as +2.
In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, check the kitchen in the morning: Lucia says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony.
Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept; the counter rises by 1, but this spot is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the rest.
Do it before Chapter 1 ends: the balcony meditation disappears after that chapter, and there is no mission replay.
Meditate at the remaining spots with both characters together; the last one needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2.
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; the 100% checklist only needs 15 of the 18.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx says it is currently unclear whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required for the trophy, although its author had done it when the trophy popped; OutputLag states the balcony meditation counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and disappears after that chapter.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: Bret's questline stays available after the story. Unconfirmed: the guides have not confirmed which animal exactly unlocks this trophy.
trophies.guide: Hunt for Bret Vogel as Jason. Which animal exactly triggers the trophy is still unconfirmed.

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, while playing as Jason, wait for Bret Vogel's text message; it marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County. Lucia cannot receive it.
Do the quest; Bret then marks hunting spots with purple icons. Hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him as Jason.

The first quest gives the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker; a clean one-shot kill keeps the carcass pristine and pays more, but is not required. All 15 Target Decks are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.missableNote: Safe: card sets stay collectible in free roam. Unconfirmed: whether 18 is the count of sets or of set locations is not settled in the sources read.
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets; the guides link card-set locations but give no step-by-step method, and the total number of sets is not settled.

steps.text: Find and complete any 3 Collectible Card sets; PowerPyx points to a guide of all 18 collectible card set locations.
The 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 card sets, so keep collecting past the trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.missableNote: Safe: WAiNK scanning stays available in free roam. Unconfirmed: the number of No Flusher Tags is not given by the guides.
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app; any 100 count.

steps.text: Open the WAiNK app on the phone (hold up) and scan objects in the world by holding R1.
Scannable types include 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities and 23 Sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags; the tag count is not given.
Any 100 locations count, so scan whatever you pass; there are more than 100 in total.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableNote: Safe: challenges stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; the checklist wants 70.

steps.text: There are 80 Challenges; complete any 50 for this trophy.
Track them under Progress > Challenges; the Completed checkmark shows in the bottom right when scrolling over a challenge.
Many complete naturally while working on other trophies; the 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so pick the easiest ones left.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: repeatable in free roam; it also pops on its own during the bank vault mission.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. It also pops naturally during the bank vault mission.

steps.text: Wait until after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Jason and Lucia can free-roam together; call your partner by holding right and pressing triangle.

Build a 4-star Wanted Level, then escape: a fast sports bike through traffic works, or drive the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. Shoot down a chasing helicopter if you must.

The trophy pops after you drive out of the red heat zone, not after leaving the flashing search area; it also pops automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, whose bank vault robberies always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.disagreement: OutputLag says switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after Breakfast Run in Chapter 2, while PowerPyx ties free-roaming together to the Coffee Break mission. Both are Chapter 2 missions.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: shop robberies are repeatable in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.

steps.text: Wait until after Chapter 2, when you can switch characters and call your partner; then hit 3 robbery targets (green map icons) in a row while the police are still chasing you.

Keep the red and blue flashing Wanted Level the whole time; if the stars fade and only the red heat zone remains, the chain breaks. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing.

A good spot is the 3 Jewelry Stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; the pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop, so hit a fourth shop if it has not popped.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.missableNote: Safe: vehicle scanning stays available in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK; you do not need to drive them.

steps.text: GTA VI has 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes); discover any 100 of them.
Use the WAiNK app on the phone (hold up to open it instantly), point it at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan; scanning is enough, driving is not needed.
Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: Combat Focus is repeatable in free roam; the trophy often pops naturally at Focus Level 4.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.

steps.text: Combat Focus activates with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm; time slows and enemy weak spots are highlighted, draining the purple focus bar under health and stamina.
Buff your focus first with food and drinks or by washing your face and showering at home; consume Adrenaline (hold L1, then triangle) to extend Combat Focus.

Gather 5 enemies, such as criminals at a Gang Operation, and defeat them quickly without missing; use an assault rifle like the Duke 556, which is more accurate than pistols and SMGs and fires full-auto.
All 5 must fall in a single use, which lasts only a few seconds; wear body armor from an Ammu-Nation so you can step out of cover and get close.

It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Focus); raise it through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, and the trophy often pops naturally at Focus Level 4.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Disputed: a top-3 entry claims a story window at the airport; the guides read here give a free-roam method with no window. Safe play: save before trying, and try it in free roam first.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a VCIA boarding bridge and fly about 1 km away. No guide source names a story window for it.

steps.text: Go to Vice City International Airport (VCIA) and steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal boarding bridge; planes parked out on the airfield do not count.
The easiest plane is at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight for it; stairs beside the boarding bridge lead through a door directly into the plane.
Inside, go upstairs, enter the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip and take off. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot.
Fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport until the trophy pops; the pop is delayed. Save first, because the police come fast.

trophies.disagreement: A top-3 entry marks this possibly missable, saying guides tie the chance to the airport's story window; no guide source read here mentions a story window or says it cannot be repeated in free roam. PowerPyx and OutputLag both describe it as a free-roam method.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.missableNote: Safe: the tank base stays accessible in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank at Mile Zero Air Station and shoot enemies until it pops.

steps.text: Go to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County; the tanks stand in the south of the base.
Get in through the gate or with the stunt jump beside the south-east entrance.
Enter a tank and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: jewelry store robberies are repeatable; if you are spotted, reload and try again.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected, using the Snap Gun on the back door.

steps.text: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs; it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and opens jewelry store robberies, marked with green icons in unfogged map areas.
Enter a jewelry store through its locked back door with the Snap Gun; kicking the door triggers the alarm. The Snap Gun stays in your inventory permanently and needs no equipping.
In the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Leave without being seen; the trophy pops shortly after leaving the store. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target, and if you are spotted, reload and try again.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.missableNote: Safe: bank vaults are repeatable after the unlocking mission; the checklist wants all 8.
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape; the checklist wants all 8.

steps.text: First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is... (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and introduces bank vault robberies.
Tail a security van until it stops at a bank; a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and the vault opens. Go in quickly while it is open and rob it.
Bring your partner: you cannot carry all the cash alone, so hold right to hand off one bag.
After the quest, pay Yasmani $10,000 for security van tips (finish his earlier quests first, including robbing 2 Payday Loans); vans are marked with a purple icon, so follow them to the bank.

Rob any 5 of the 8 Large Bank Jobs; the checklist needs all 8, worth up to $205,000 per bank. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star Wanted Level, so escape on a fast bike and then switch vehicles to become unrecognizable.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: armored trucks keep driving around Vice City in free roam, and the mission method always works.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the bank vault mission, or earlier on the street.

steps.text: It unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is...: tailing the armored truck to the bank and robbing the vault counts as robbing an armored truck.

To get it earlier, find an armored truck driving around Vice City near banks, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it up. Sticky bombs are behind Yasmani's shop after his quests; Yasmani becomes a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
The trophy pops only after escaping the red heat radius, or after using a Pay 'n' Spray.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.missableNote: Safe: map exploration stays available in free roam. Unconfirmed: the figure of 52 areas, taken from a trophy list, was not verified in any guide read here.
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida by unfogging the whole map; flying a plane over the fog is fastest.

steps.text: Unfog the whole map by flying over every area still covered in black fog until the entire map is visible.
A plane is the fastest way to cover the fog; the guides do not give a verified count of areas, so follow the map itself.

trophies.targetLabel: areas of Leonida (count not verified in the guides read)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: gang operations stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Rob one Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs; the checklist wants all 39.

steps.text: There are 9 gangs and 39 Illegal Gang Operations; rob at least 1 operation from each gang for this trophy.
Operations are marked by yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress.
Track progress under Progress > Gangs; scrolling over a gang shows in the bottom right how many of its operations you have robbed. The 100% checklist needs all 39.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: the bar stays open in free roam. Unconfirmed: OutputLag lists the trigger as not yet confirmed, against PowerPyx's method.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx gives a method; OutputLag still lists the trigger as unconfirmed.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.
Buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar; the trophy should pop.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx gives a method (Ocean View Rooftop Bar, Apple Martini, drink beside the bar), while OutputLag lists this trophy among those with no confirmed trigger yet.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: repeatable after the Key Cloner is unlocked. Unconfirmed: OutputLag lists the trigger as not yet confirmed, against PowerPyx's method.
trophies.guide: Smash out of a vehicle showroom in the blue Banshee, an easter egg for the Banshee from GTA III. PowerPyx gives a method; OutputLag still lists the trigger as unconfirmed.

steps.text: Get the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy); only then can the car be stolen.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee there; only this blue Banshee counts, not any other car.
Drive straight forward through the showroom window; the pop is slightly delayed and comes after you drive further down the street.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx gives a method (blue Banshee, Key Cloner, through the showroom window), while OutputLag lists this trophy among those with no confirmed trigger yet.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: the robbery icon respawns after a long time, so the 3 valuables need not be taken in one visit.
trophies.guide: Steal the 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling and escape the police.

steps.text: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is the Kolt & Associates alley and one of the Gang Operations; visit it during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically.
Buy Sticky Bombs from an Ammu-Nation first; you need them to blow open the safe.

Take the 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the contents of the safe in the north-east hallway office, blown open with a Sticky Bomb.

The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item. If you miss one, the robbery icon respawns after a long time and you can return for what is left; you do not need all 3 in one visit.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: Safe: gyms stay open in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with Jason and Lucia at the same time.

steps.text: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time; check levels under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength (heart icon).
You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when switching between both characters opens; buy a gym membership at a fitness club to work out.

Always go together (hold right and press triangle to call your partner): while one character works out, the other trains automatically, so progress is doubled. Filter fitness clubs on Map > Activities (dumbbell icon); there are many in Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Safe: the count fills passively during other trophies and stays available in free roam.
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile; it fills up passively while you play.

steps.text: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile; check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On); a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever your reputation changes.

Profiles run from Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes) through Hardened (incapacitate without killing) and Violent to Psycho, with Irredeemable permanent if you use excessive violence, so avoid that. The count fills passively during other trophies; if you are short, farming by running over civilians and police works, but police shoot on sight more at Psycho or Irredeemable.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Safe: nothing suggests it can be missed. Trigger not known: PowerPyx says only that it is believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue, and OutputLag lists it as no confirmed trigger yet.
trophies.guide: Trigger not known. The only lead is a guess tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue; do not treat it as a method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.missableNote: Safe: repeatable in free roam. Unconfirmed: OutputLag lists the trigger as not yet confirmed and gives different leads from PowerPyx's method.
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg, per PowerPyx. OutputLag lists the trigger as unconfirmed and offers two different leads.

steps.text: Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night after 2AM, and come alone; the spawn is slightly random and not guaranteed.
If a blinking car is at the roadside, follow the path beside it into the woods; you will see the UFO as a bright blue light in the sky. If the car is not there, drive away and come back.
Approach the UFO; it drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her, offer to help, and when she asks, go back to her car at the roadside; doing so pops the trophy.

trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx gives a UFO method (Starlet Motel road, after 2AM, blinking car, escort the abducted woman back to her car), while OutputLag lists the trophy as no confirmed trigger yet and offers two other leads: a glowing-graffiti six-digit code opening a safe in Crosstown, and a UFO abduction side story Lucia can find in Chapter 2 with a keypad code for the Abandoned Site.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: repeatable in free roam. Unconfirmed: OutputLag lists the trigger as not yet confirmed, against PowerPyx's method.
trophies.guide: Bowl pedestrians over with a melee drive-by from a bike, per PowerPyx. OutputLag still lists the trigger as unconfirmed.

steps.text: Ride any bike in a crowded area like Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Kick 10 pedestrians with square within 60 seconds to pop the trophy.

trophies.targetLabel: pedestrians kicked from a bike in 60 seconds
trophies.disagreement: PowerPyx gives a method (bike, kick 10 pedestrians with square within 60 seconds), while OutputLag lists the trophy as no confirmed trigger yet and KeenGamer also says the precise method is still being confirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: fences stay available in free roam after the story; the total is cumulative.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts; the total is cumulative.

steps.text: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew); it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a Fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.

Deliver $250,000 in total; it counts across all robberies, so you do not need to bring it all at once. Bank vaults give up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but only open after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.missableNote: Safe: shops stay open in free roam after the story; the total is cumulative.
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops; guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest.

steps.text: Spend $100,000 in total across all types of shops; the total is cumulative.

Buying guns, car mods and tattoos is the fastest method, as these are the most expensive. Shop counts include 14 Mod Shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 Clothing Stores, 17 Footwear Stores, 18 Hair & Beauty Salons, 11 Tattoo Studios and 15 Electronics Stores.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.missableNote: Safe: garages stay buyable in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages for $160,000 in total; story garages do not count.

steps.text: There are 8 purchasable garages and 4 story-related garages; only the 8 purchasable ones count, costing $160,000 in total.
Garages become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses); you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone.
Buy the garages through the phone app. A quick way to make the money is robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3-4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.missableNote: Safe: registrations stay available in free roam after the story.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app; buy garages first so you have parking spaces.

steps.text: The Scooter Bros app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses).

Buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes), since each garage adds parking spots for registered vehicles; then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, click Respray and then Register.

At first Moses only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3, cars with Standard Trackers can also be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
